content: संसिद्धिः {%f.%} .²1 Completion, complete accomplishment or attainment; स्वनुष्ठितस्य धर्मस्य संसिद्धिर्हरितोषणम् <ls>Bhāg. 1. 2. 13</ls>; <ls>Ku. 2. 63</ls>; <ls>Ms. 6. 29</ls>. .²2 Absolution, final beatitude; संसिद्धिं परमां गताः <ls>Bg. 8. 15</ls>, <ls n="Bg.">3. 20</ls>. .²3 Nature, natural disposition, state or quality. .²4 A passionate or intoxicated woman. .²5 The last consequence, result. .²6 The last decisive word.
